tiles.markdownText:
## Runner Environments
AL-Go supports both GitHub-hosted runners and self-hosted runners. In the tiles below you can get an overview over which environments AL-Go actions are running in.

## Runner OS
AL-Go also supports running certain jobs on linux. You can learn more about that [here](https://github.com/microsoft/AL-Go/blob/main/Scenarios/SelfHostedGitHubRunner.md#githubrunner-vs-runs-on)

tiles.markdownText:
## Reliability
Workflow outcomes exclude Pull Request Build unless a tile explicitly says otherwise. Empty results are reported as **No telemetry**, not healthy.

## Run Explorer
Filter by repository, workflow, ref, conclusion, or RunId. GitHub links open the original workflow run. Raw error messages are operationally sensitive.

## Tests & Quality
Aggregate AL-Go test, page scripting, and BCPT results. Test telemetry is emitted only when AL-Go executes at least one test, so **No telemetry** is expected for repositories without test runs. BCPT does not emit TotalTime, so duration visuals exclude BCPT.

tiles.title: Execution Runtime & Supportability
tiles.description: One row per repository using the latest telemetry in the selected range. BcContainerHelper shows the latest action that reported the module as loaded; Not loaded/reported is not an installation failure. Set the optional expected version to assess drift.

  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isempty(_refName) or RefName == _refName
  | where isempty(_testType) or TestType == _testType
  | summarize Total=sum(TotalTests * ItemCount), Passed=sum(TotalPassed * ItemCount), Failed=sum(TotalFailed * ItemCount), Skipped=sum(TotalSkipped * ItemCount) by RepositoryName, TestType
  | extend PassRatePct=iff(Total == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Passed / Total, 1))
  | order by Failed desc, Total desc

TestTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isempty(_refName) or RefName == _refName
  | where isempty(_testType) or TestType == _testType
| project timestamp, RepositoryName, WorkflowName, RefName, TestType, TotalTests, TotalPassed, TotalFailed, TotalSkipped, TotalTimeSeconds, RunId, HtmlUrl
| top 500 by timestamp desc

TestTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isempty(_refName) or RefName == _refName
  | where isempty(_testType) or TestType == _testType
  | where TestType != "BCPT Tests" and isnotnull(TotalTimeSeconds)
  | summarize Runs=sum(ItemCount), P50Minutes=round(percentilew(TotalTimeSeconds / 60.0, ItemCount, 50), 1), P95Minutes=round(percentilew(TotalTimeSeconds / 60.0, ItemCount, 95), 1) by RepositoryName, TestType
  | order by P95Minutes desc

WorkflowTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isempty(_repoType) or RepoType == _repoType
  | where isnotempty(ALGoVersion)
  | summarize arg_max(timestamp, ALGoVersion) by RepositoryName
  | summarize Repositories=count() by ALGoVersion
  | order by Repositories desc

let LatestActionRuntime = materialize(
  ActionTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isnotempty(RepositoryName)
  | summarize arg_max(timestamp, PowerShellVersion, WorkflowName, ActionName, HtmlUrl) by RepositoryName
  | project RepositoryName,
            PowerShellVersion=iff(isempty(PowerShellVersion), "Not reported", PowerShellVersion),
            RuntimeLastSeenUTC=timestamp,
            WorkflowName,
            ActionName,
            HtmlUrl
);
let LatestBcContainerHelper = materialize(
  ActionTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isnotempty(RepositoryName) and isnotempty(BcContainerHelperVersion)
  | summarize arg_max(timestamp, BcContainerHelperVersion) by RepositoryName
  | project RepositoryName,
            BcContainerHelperVersion,
            BcContainerHelperLastSeenUTC=timestamp
);
let LatestWorkflowRuntime = materialize(
  WorkflowTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isempty(_repoType) or RepoType == _repoType
  | where isnotempty(RepositoryName)
  | summarize arg_max(timestamp, RepoType, ALGoVersion) by RepositoryName
  | project RepositoryName, RepoType, ALGoVersion
);
LatestActionRuntime
| join kind=leftouter LatestBcContainerHelper on RepositoryName
| join kind=leftouter LatestWorkflowRuntime on RepositoryName
| where isempty(_repoType) or RepoType == _repoType
| extend BcContainerHelperStatus=case(
    isempty(BcContainerHelperVersion), "Not loaded/reported",
    isempty(_bcContainerHelperBaseline), "Observed (baseline not set)",
    BcContainerHelperVersion == _bcContainerHelperBaseline, "Matches baseline",
    "Different from baseline")
| extend BcContainerHelperVersion=iff(isempty(BcContainerHelperVersion), "Not loaded/reported", BcContainerHelperVersion),
         ALGoVersion=iff(isempty(ALGoVersion), "Not reported", ALGoVersion)
| project RepositoryName,
          RepoType,
          ALGoVersion,
          PowerShellVersion,
          BcContainerHelperVersion,
          BcContainerHelperStatus,
          RuntimeLastSeenUTC,
          BcContainerHelperLastSeenUTC,
          WorkflowName,
          ActionName,
          HtmlUrl
| top 500 by RuntimeLastSeenUTC desc

ActionTelemetry
  | where isempty(_repository) or RepositoryName == _repository
  | where isempty(_workflow) or WorkflowName == _workflow
  | where isempty(_refName) or RefName == _refName
  | where isempty(_runnerEnvironment) or RunnerEnvironment == _runnerEnvironment
  | where isempty(_runnerOs) or RunnerOs == _runnerOs
  | where isnotnull(ActionDurationSeconds) and ActionDurationSeconds > 0 and isnotempty(ActionName)
  | summarize Runs=sum(ItemCount), P50Seconds=round(percentilew(ActionDurationSeconds, ItemCount, 50), 1), P95Seconds=round(percentilew(ActionDurationSeconds, ItemCount, 95), 1) by ActionName, RunnerEnvironment, RunnerOs
  | top 30 by P95Seconds desc
